subject: Bright Harbor onboarding — PO issuance, temporary spend cap, and one line-item discrepancy
messages:
From: Rachel Burns <rachel@brightharbor.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightharbor.com
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Bright Harbor onboarding — onboarding form + W9 attached

Hi Vivek / Monica,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on access for our integration testing. Attached are our completed onboarding form and W9 so your procurement team can kick off PO issuance. A few notes:

- We requested a provisional PO earlier in the vendor portal but didn’t see a number assigned. We need a PO for our internal billing (Bright Harbor finance) to accept the first invoice.
- Our expected order for Dec is 2 line items: 1) Monthly compute credits (SKU: BH-CPU-STD) — qty 1, estimated $8,000; 2) Integration services (SKU: BH-INTEG) — qty 1, estimated $18,000.
- If you need alternate SKUs or a different spend cap format, let us know.

Attachments: BrightHarbor_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf), BrightHarbor_W9.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Rachel Burns
Vendor Ops | Bright Harbor Logistics
rachel@brightharbor.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Bright Harbor onboarding — onboarding form + W9 attached

Monica / Karthik / Olga — looping you in.

Quick summary from Rachel: onboarding form + W9 attached, vendor is requesting an assigned PO so Bright Harbor finance can process the first invoice. They list two SKUs and ~$26k total.

Can Procurement issue a provisional PO with a temporary spend cap (we typically do provisional + 30-day review) and confirm line item codes? Also:
- Confirm whether we should issue a single PO covering both line items or two separate POs (we usually prefer one PO per vendor onboarding unless they ask otherwise).
- If there's an expected variance on item 2 pricing, flag now so Accounting doesn’t block invoice.

Olga — can you check tax & compliance quickly (W9 attached) and confirm any finance hold?
Karthik — if you agree, please generate the provisional PO and put "provisional" in the filename; I'll send to Rachel.

Thanks — Vivek
Head of GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Burns <rachel@brightharbor.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bright Harbor onboarding — PO (provisional) issued: PO-2026-7791

Hi Rachel — thanks for the attachments. We’ve reviewed the W9 and intake form.

Provisional PO issued: PO-2026-7791 (provisional). Temporary spend cap set to USD 25,000 while we complete the first-month reconciliation. We put both SKUs on a single PO as requested. Please note the provisional tag — final PO will follow after first invoice clears finance review.

Key items:
- PO: PO-2026-7791-provisional.pdf (attached) — contains line-item mapping to our internal ledger codes.
- Spend cap: USD 25,000 (flag is set in procurement system; any invoice above this will require pre-approval).
- Action for Bright Harbor: please confirm line-level unit pricing for the Integration services (BH-INTEG) — the onboarding form listed $18,000 estimated but we need an itemized unit price to populate accounting fields.

Rachel — can you reply with a one-line confirmation of unit prices or attach an invoice stub? That will let us finalize the PO next business day.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai
Attachment: PO-2026-7791-provisional.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Rachel Burns <rachel@brightharbor.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@brightharbor.com>, Bright Harbor Finance <finance@brightharbor.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bright Harbor onboarding — PO (provisional) issued: PO-2026-7791

Monica — thanks, we received PO-2026-7791-provisional.pdf. Two quick clarifications from our finance lead:

1) Line item mapping OK. However, unit price for BH-INTEG was entered as $18,000 for the integration block. When we prepared the invoice stub we split that into 3 deliverable milestones (3 x $6,000) — the provisional PO has it as a single line of $18,000.
2) The invoice stub we attempted to upload had the milestone rows; can you accept milestone-level line items or do you need us to reissue a single-line invoice?

Attaching export of our invoice CSV for the first-month billing: lineitem_correction_20261208.csv (text/csv) — highlights the milestone split. If Redwood prefers milestone lines we can reformat the PO; if Redwood needs single-line mapping for now, we can consolidate on our side and resubmit the invoice as $18,000 single line.

Apologies for the back-and-forth — trying to avoid invoice rejections on our side. Please advise and we’ll update the stub.

Thanks,
Rachel Burns
Bright Harbor Logistics
Attachment: lineitem_correction_20261208.csv (text/csv)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Burns <rachel@brightharbor.com>, Procurement Ops <procurement@brightharbor.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Bright Harbor onboarding — PO-2026-7791 finalization

All — quick update and final step. We reviewed the vendor's CSV and agree to accept milestone-level lines on the PO. I created a final PO that expands BH-INTEG into three milestone lines (6,000 each) to match Bright Harbor's invoice. We bumped the provisional spend cap from 25,000 to 26,500 to leave a 7% buffer while the first invoice processes.

Final PO: PO-2026-7791-final.pdf (attached) — please note new ledger mapping for the three BH-INTEG milestones. Accounting has been notified and will accept the first invoice formatted with milestone rows.

Monica / Olga: please keep the procurement record open until accounting clears invoice. Vivek: closing loop with Bright Harbor; Rachel — confirm you received the final, and we'll ask Bright Harbor finance to proceed.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
Attachment: PO-2026-7791-final.pdf (application/pdf)
